## Quick Start

```bash
brew install uv  # macOS
```

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "blender": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["blender-mcp"] }
  }
}
```

Install the [Blender addon](https://github.com/MCPBlender/blender-mcp/raw/main/addon.py), click **Connect to Claude**, and start prompting.
